name: Box Squat
notes: Sit back onto a chair or box, stand back up. Lightly touch and go.

name: Bodyweight Squat
notes: Feet shoulder-width, sit the hips back and down, chest tall.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (bodyweight)
notes: Rear foot elevated on a chair; lower the back knee toward the floor.

name: Glute Bridge
notes: Lie on your back, drive the hips up, squeeze the glutes at the top.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
notes: Same as glute bridge with one foot lifted.

name: Single-Leg RDL (bodyweight)
notes: Hinge at the hips on one leg, arms free for balance; keep the back flat.

name: Incline Push-Up
notes: Hands on a sturdy elevated surface, body in a straight line.

name: Push-Up
notes: Hands on the floor, body in a straight line, elbows ~45 degrees from the torso.

name: Decline Push-Up
notes: Feet elevated on a chair or step.

name: Table Inverted Row (bent knees)
notes: Lie under a sturdy table, knees bent, pull the chest to the table edge.

name: Table Inverted Row
notes: Same as the bent-knee version with legs straight.

name: Dead Bug
notes: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly, keep the low back pressed to the floor.

name: Plank
notes: Forearms and toes on the floor, body in a straight line.

name: Bird Dog
notes: Extend the opposite arm and leg slowly, pause at full extension, keep the hips square.

name: Side Plank (knees bent)
notes: Knees bent and stacked, prop up on one forearm, hips lifted.

name: Side Plank
notes: Stack the feet, prop up on one forearm, hips lifted.

name: Curl-Up
notes: Lift the shoulder blades a few inches off the floor, low back stays down -- this isn't a sit-up.

name: Bicycle Crunch
notes: Opposite elbow to opposite knee, slow and controlled, not a speed drill.

name: Knee Tuck Hold
notes: Seated or lying, knees pulled toward the chest, hold without the low back rounding.

name: Leg Raise (bent knee)
notes: Lying on your back, knees bent to 90 degrees, lower and raise without arching the low back.

name: Leg Raise (straight leg)
notes: Same as the bent-knee version with legs straight -- stop the set before the low back arches.

name: Diamond Push-Up
notes: Hands together under the chest, thumbs and index fingers touching, elbows stay close to the torso.

name: Pike Push-Up
notes: Hips high, hands and feet on the floor forming an inverted V, lower the crown of the head toward the floor.

name: Chair Dip
notes: Hands on a sturdy chair edge behind you, heels forward, lower and press back up.

name: DB Goblet Squat
notes: Hold one dumbbell vertically at the chest, squat between the knees.

name: DB Romanian Deadlift
notes: Hinge at the hips, dumbbells stay close to the legs, slight knee bend.

name: DB Floor Press
notes: Lie on the floor, press dumbbells straight up over the shoulders.

name: DB Bench Press
notes: Same as the floor press with a full range of motion on a bench.

name: DB Bent-Over Row
notes: Hinge forward ~45 degrees, pull the elbows past the ribs.

name: DB Farmer's Carry
notes: Trips of ~30m each, walk tall with shoulders back.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
notes: Loop a band over the bar and under a knee or foot for assistance.

name: Weighted Vest Split Squat
notes: Wear the vest, hands free at your sides for balance only -- no grip or arm load.

name: Sled Push (hip harness)
notes: Pull from a hip harness, hands empty at your sides -- no grip or arm load.

name: Belt Squat
notes: Load hangs from a belt around the hips -- no grip or arm load.

name: Barbell Back Squat
notes: Bar racked across the upper back, squat to depth.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
notes: Hinge at the hips holding the bar, bar stays close to the legs.
